title: Together for Prosperity on a New Journey! 2026 China Fuzhou International Investment Month Opens
description: Fuzhou, China, May 23, 2026 -- The 2026 China Fuzhou International Investment Promotion Month Launch Ceremony, as well as the Together for Prosperity in Fuzhou: Global Investment Promotion Conference, was held on the afternoon of May 22 at the Fuzhou Strait International Conference and Exhibition Center. The event was hosted by the CPC Fuzhou Municipal Committee, the Fuzhou Municipal People's Government, and the Fujian Provincial Investment Promotion Bureau. Centered on carrying forward and deepening the important vision and practices initiated by President Xi Jinping during his tenure in Fuzhou-specifically the initiation of the 'China Fuzhou International Investment Promotion Month'-the conference focused on the theme 'Together for Prosperity in Fuzhou.' It mobilized authorities at all levels to adopt a comprehensive, full-process, full-chain, full-lifecycle, and widely-participated approach to investment promotion, extending an invitation to global investors to jointly seize new development opportunities brought by the latest wave of technological revolution and industrial transformation, and to achieve mutual success through two-way engagement and empowerment.
